record ModNum, value : Int64 do
  @@factorials = Array(ModNum).new(2_000_000_i64) # Change here to improve performance

  def self.factorial(n)
    if @@factorials.empty?
      @@factorials << ModNum.new(1_i64)
    end
    @@factorials.size.upto(n) do |i|
      @@factorials << @@factorials.last * i
    end
    @@factorials[n]
  end

  def self.permutation(n, k)
    raise ArgumentError.new("k cannot be greater than n") unless n >= k
    factorial(n) // factorial(n - k)
  end

  def self.combination(n, k)
    raise ArgumentError.new("k cannot be greater than n") unless n >= k
    permutation(n, k) // @@factorials[k]
  end

  def self.repeated_combination(n, k)
    combination(n + k - 1, k)
  end

  def self.extended_gcd(a, b)
    last_remainder, remainder = a.abs, b.abs
    x, last_x, y, last_y = 0_i64, 1_i64, 1_i64, 0_i64
    while remainder != 0
      new_last_remainder = remainder
      quotient, remainder = last_remainder.divmod(remainder)
      last_remainder = new_last_remainder
      x, last_x = last_x - quotient * x, x
      y, last_y = last_y - quotient * y, y
    end

    return last_remainder, last_x * (a < 0 ? -1 : 1)
  end

  def self.zero
    ModNum.new(0_i64)
  end

  def inv
    g, x = ModNum.extended_gcd(@value, MOD)
    ModNum.new(x % MOD)
  end

  def +(value)
    ModNum.new((@value + value.to_i64 % MOD) % MOD)
  end

  def -(value)
    ModNum.new((@value + MOD - value.to_i64 % MOD) % MOD)
  end

  def *(value)
    ModNum.new((@value * value.to_i64 % MOD) % MOD)
  end

  def /(value : ModNum)
    raise DivisionByZeroError.new if value == 0
    self * value.inv
  end

  def /(value)
    raise DivisionByZeroError.new if value == 0
    self * ModNum.new(value.to_i64 % MOD).inv
  end

  def //(value)
    self./(value)
  end

  def **(value)
    b = value > 0 ? self : self.inv
    e = value.abs
    ret = ModNum.new(1_i64)
    while e > 0
      if e % 2 == 1
        ret *= b
      end
      b *= b
      e //= 2
    end
    ret
  end

  def <<(value)
    self * ModNum.new(2_i64) ** value
  end

  def sqrt
    z = ModNum.new(1_i64)
    until z ** ((MOD - 1) // 2) == MOD - 1
      z += 1
    end
    q = MOD - 1
    m = 0
    while q % 2 == 0
      q //= 2
      m += 1
    end
    c = z ** q
    t = self ** q
    r = self ** ((q + 1) // 2)
    m.downto(2) do |i|
      tmp = t ** (2 ** (i - 2))
      if tmp != 1
        r *= c
        t *= c ** 2
      end
      c *= c
    end
    if r * r == self
      r.to_i64 * 2 <= MOD ? r : -r
    else
      nil
    end
  end

  def to_i64
    @value
  end

  def ==(value : ModNum)
    @value == value.to_i64
  end

  def ==(value)
    @value == value
  end

  def -
    ModNum.new(0_i64) - self
  end

  def +
    self
  end

  def abs
    self
  end

  # ModNum shouldn't be compared
  def <(value)
    raise NotImplementedError.new("<")
  end
  def <=(value)
    raise NotImplementedError.new("<=")
  end
  def <(value)
    raise NotImplementedError.new("<")
  end
  def >=(value)
    raise NotImplementedError.new(">=")
  end

  delegate to_s, to: @value
  delegate inspect, to: @value
end

# MODを法とした階乗、組み合わせ
class ModCombination
  property :mod, :fac, :inv, :finv

  def initialize(n : Int64, mod : Int64 = MOD)
    @mod = mod
    @fac = Array(Int64).new(n+1, 1)
    @inv = Array(Int64).new(n+1, 1)
    @finv = Array(Int64).new(n+1, 1)

    (2..n).each do |i|
      fac[i] = fac[i - 1] * i % mod
      inv[i] = mod - inv[mod % i] * (mod // i) % mod
      finv[i] = finv[i - 1] * inv[i] % mod
    end
  end

  def combination(n, k)
    return 0 if n < k
    return 0 if n < 0 || k < 0

    fac[n] * (finv[k] * finv[n - k] % mod) % mod
  end

  def repeated_combination(n, k)
    combination(n + k - 1, k)
  end
end

def pow(v, p)
  ret = 1i64
  while p > 0
    if (p & 1i64) != 0
      ret *= v
      ret %= MOD
    end
    v *= v
    v %= MOD
    p >>= 1
  end
  ret
end

class Combination:
    def __init__(self, n_max, mod=10**9+7):
        # O(n_max + log(mod))
        self.mod = mod
        f = 1
        self.fac = fac = [f]
        for i in range(1, n_max+1):
            f = f * i % mod
            fac.append(f)
        f = pow(f, mod-2, mod)
        self.facinv = facinv = [f]
        for i in range(n_max, 0, -1):
            f = f * i % mod
            facinv.append(f)
        facinv.reverse()

    # "n 要素" は区別できる n 要素
    # "k グループ" はちょうど k グループ

    def __call__(self, n, r):  # self.C と同じ
        return self.fac[n] * self.facinv[r] % self.mod * self.facinv[n-r] % self.mod

# x ** a をmodで割った余りを、O(log(a))時間で求める。
def power(x, a, mod=int(1e9+7)):
    if a == 0:
        return 1
    elif a == 1:
        return x
    elif a % 2 == 0:
        return power(x, a//2) **2 % mod
    else:
        return power(x, a//2) **2 * x % mod

# xの逆元を求める。フェルマーの小定理より、 x の逆元は x ^ (mod - 2) に等しい。計算時間はO(log(mod))程度。
# https://qiita.com/Yaruki00/items/fd1fc269ff7fe40d09a6
def modinv(x, mod=int(1e9+7)):
    return power(x, mod-2)

def comb(n, k, mod = int(1e9+7)):
    numera = 1  # 分子
    denomi = 1  # 分母

    for i in range(k):
        numera *= n-i
        numera %= mod
        denomi *= i+1
        denomi %= mod
    return numera * modinv(denomi) % mod

module module_swap
    use, intrinsic :: iso_fortran_env
    implicit none
    private
    public swap

    interface swap
        module procedure swap_scalar
    end interface

contains

    subroutine swap_scalar( lhs, rhs )
        class(*) :: lhs, rhs
        class(*), allocatable :: tmp, a, b

        allocate(a, source = lhs)
        allocate(b, source = rhs)

        call move_alloc(b, tmp)
        call move_alloc(a, b)
        call move_alloc(tmp, a)
        call bytes_to_anything(a, lhs)
        call bytes_to_anything(b, rhs)

    contains

        subroutine bytes_to_anything(bytes, anything)
            class(*) :: bytes
            class(*) :: anything

            select type(anything)
            type is ( character(*) )
                anything = transfer(bytes, anything)
            type is ( complex(real32) )
                anything = transfer(bytes, anything)
            type is ( complex(real64) )
                anything = transfer(bytes, anything)
            type is ( integer(int8) )
                anything = transfer(bytes, anything)
            type is ( integer(int16 ))
                anything = transfer(bytes, anything)
            type is ( integer(int32) )
                anything = transfer(bytes, anything)
            type is ( integer(int64) )
                anything = transfer(bytes, anything)
            type is ( real(real32) )
                anything = transfer(bytes, anything)
            type is ( real(real64) )
                anything = transfer(bytes, anything)
            type is ( real(real128) )
                anything = transfer(bytes, anything)
            class default
                stop 'bytes_to_anything(1) does not know about this type'
            end select

        end subroutine bytes_to_anything

    end subroutine swap_scalar

end module module_swap

        generic :: operator(-) => sub

        integer(int64), intent(in) :: i

            res = modulo(i, modulus)

module module_swap
    use, intrinsic :: iso_fortran_env
    implicit none
    private
    public swap

    interface swap
        module procedure swap_scalar
    end interface

contains

    subroutine swap_scalar( lhs, rhs )
        class(*) :: lhs, rhs
        class(*), allocatable :: tmp, a, b

        allocate(a, source = lhs)
        allocate(b, source = rhs)

        call move_alloc(b, tmp)
        call move_alloc(a, b)
        call move_alloc(tmp, a)
        call bytes_to_anything(a, lhs)
        call bytes_to_anything(b, rhs)

    contains

        subroutine bytes_to_anything(bytes, anything)
            class(*) :: bytes
            class(*) :: anything

            select type(anything)
            type is ( character(*) )
                anything = transfer(bytes, anything)
            type is ( complex(real32) )
                anything = transfer(bytes, anything)
            type is ( complex(real64) )
                anything = transfer(bytes, anything)
            type is ( integer(int8) )
                anything = transfer(bytes, anything)
            type is ( integer(int16 ))
                anything = transfer(bytes, anything)
            type is ( integer(int32) )
                anything = transfer(bytes, anything)
            type is ( integer(int64) )
                anything = transfer(bytes, anything)
            type is ( real(real32) )
                anything = transfer(bytes, anything)
            type is ( real(real64) )
                anything = transfer(bytes, anything)
            type is ( real(real128) )
                anything = transfer(bytes, anything)
            class default
                stop 'bytes_to_anything(1) does not know about this type'
            end select

        end subroutine bytes_to_anything

    end subroutine swap_scalar

module module_modint
    use, intrinsic :: iso_fortran_env
    use module_swap
    implicit none
    private
    public :: modint, set_modulus, modulo_utils, permutation, combination

    type modint
        private
        integer(int64) :: val
    contains
        procedure :: n => get
        procedure :: add
        procedure :: sub
        procedure :: mul
        procedure :: inv
        procedure :: div
        procedure :: pow
        generic :: operator(+) => add
        generic :: operator(-) => sub
        generic :: operator(*) => mul
        generic :: operator(/) => div
        generic :: operator(**) => pow
    end type

    integer(int64) :: modulus = 1000000007
    type(modint), allocatable :: f(:), invf(:)

    interface modint
        module procedure :: init_modint
    end interface modint

    interface modulo_utils
        module procedure :: init_modulo_utils
    end interface modulo_utils

contains

    integer(int64) function mval(i) result(res)
        integer(int64), intent(in) :: i

        if ( (0_int64 <= i) .and. (i < modulus) ) then
            res = i
        else
            res = modulo(i, modulus)
        endif

    end function mval


    integer(int64) function to_int64(i) result(res)
        class(*), intent(in) :: i

        select type(i)
        type is (integer(int64))
            res = int(i, int64)
        type is (integer(int32))
            res = int(i, int64)
        type is (integer(int16))
            res = int(i, int64)
        type is (integer(int8))
            res = int(i, int64)
        end select

    end function to_int64


    subroutine set_modulus(m)
        class(*), intent(in) :: m

        select type(m)
        type is (modint)
            modulus = m%val
        class default
            modulus = to_int64(m)
        end select

    end subroutine set_modulus


    type(modint) function init_modint(i) result(res)
        class(*), intent(in) :: i

        select type(i)
        type is (modint)
            res%val = i%val
        class default
            res%val = mval( to_int64(i) )
        end select

    end function init_modint


    function get(this) result(res)
        class(modint), intent(in) :: this
        integer(int64) :: res

        res = this%val

    end function get


    type(modint) function add(this, other) result(res)
        class(modint), intent(in) :: this
        type(modint), intent(in) :: other

        res%val = mval( this%val + other%val )

    end function add


    type(modint) function sub(this, other) result(res)
        class(modint), intent(in) :: this
        type(modint), intent(in) :: other

        res%val = mval( this%val - other%val )

    end function sub


    type(modint) function mul(this, other) result(res)
        class(modint), intent(in) :: this
        type(modint), intent(in) :: other

        res%val = mval( this%val * other%val )

    end function mul


    type(modint) function div(this, other) result(res)
        class(modint), intent(in) :: this
        type(modint), intent(in) :: other

        res = this%mul( other%inv() )

    end function div


    type(modint) function inv(this) result(res)
        implicit none
        class(modint), intent(in) :: this
        integer(int64) :: a, b, u, v, t

        a = this%val
        b = modulus
        u = 1
        v = 0

        do while ( b /= 0 )
            t = a / b
            a = a - t * b
            call swap(a, b)
            u = u - t * v
            call swap(u, v)
        enddo

        res%val = modulo(u, modulus)

    end function inv

    type(modint) function pow(this, other) result(res)
        implicit none
        class(modint), intent(in) :: this
        class(*), intent(in) :: other
        integer(int64) :: n
        type(modint) :: i

        res%val = mval( to_int64(1) )
        i%val = this%val
        n = to_int64(other)

        do while (n > 0_8)
            if (btest(n, 0)) res = res%mul(i)
            i = i%mul(i)
            n = rshift(n, 1)
        end do

    end function pow

    subroutine init_modulo_utils(i)
        class(*), intent(in) :: i
        integer(int64) :: k, n

        if ( allocated(f) ) deallocate(f)
        if ( allocated(invf) ) deallocate(invf)

        select type(i)
        type is (modint)
            n = i%val
        class default
            n = to_int64(i)
        end select

        allocate( f(0:n) )
        allocate( invf(0:n) )

        f(0) = modint(1)
        do k = 1, n
            f(k) = f(k-1) * modint(k)
        enddo

        invf(n) = f(n)%inv()
        do k = n, 1, -1
            invf(k-1) = invf(k) * modint(k)
        enddo

    end subroutine init_modulo_utils


    type(modint) function permutation(n, k)
        class(*), intent(in) :: n, k
        integer(int64) :: nt, kt

        select type(n)
        type is (integer(int64))
            nt = n
        class default
            nt = to_int64(n)
        end select

        select type(k)
        type is (integer(int64))
            kt = k
        class default
            kt = to_int64(k)
        end select

        if ( (kt > nt) .or. (nt < 0) .or. (kt < 0) ) return
        permutation = f(nt) * invf(nt-kt)

    end function permutation


    type(modint) function combination(n, k)
        class(*), intent(in) :: n, k
        integer(int64) :: nt, kt

        select type(n)
        type is (integer(int64))
            nt = n
        class default
            nt = to_int64(n)
        end select

        select type(k)
        type is (integer(int64))
            kt = k
        class default
            kt = to_int64(k)
        end select

        combination = permutation(nt, kt) * invf(kt)

    end function combination

end module module_modint

module module_modint
  use, intrinsic :: iso_fortran_env
  implicit none
  integer(int64) :: modu = 1000000007
  type modint
    integer(int64), private :: val = 0
  contains
    procedure, private :: asgn => asgn
    procedure, private :: add => add
    procedure, private :: sub => sub
    procedure, private :: mul => mul
    procedure, private :: div => div
    procedure, private :: pow => pow
    procedure, public :: inv => inv
    procedure, public :: get => get
    generic, public :: assignment(=) => asgn
    generic, public :: operator(+) => add
    generic, public :: operator(-) => sub
    generic, public :: operator(*) => mul
    generic, public :: operator(/) => div
    generic, public :: operator(**) => pow
  end type
  interface modint
    module procedure :: new_modint, new_modint_with_num
  end interface modint
  interface operator(+)
    module procedure :: add_r
  end interface
  interface operator(-)
    module procedure :: sub_r
  end interface
  interface operator(*)
    module procedure :: mul_r
  end interface
  interface operator(/)
    module procedure :: div_r
  end interface
  interface dot_product
    module procedure :: dot_prod
  end interface dot_product
  interface matmul
    module procedure :: matmul1, matmul2, matmul3
  end interface matmul
contains
  pure elemental integer(int64) function to_int64(num) result(res)
    class(*), intent(in) :: num
    select type (num)
    type is (integer(int64))
      res = num
    type is (integer(int32))
      res = int(num, int64)
    type is (integer(int16))
      res = int(num, int64)
    type is (integer(int8))
      res = int(num, int64)
    class default
      res = 0_8
      res = 1_8 / res
    end select
  end
  pure elemental type(modint) function new_modint()
  end
  pure elemental type(modint) function new_modint_with_num(num) result(res)
    class(*), intent(in) :: num
    res%val = to_int64(num)
  end
  pure elemental subroutine asgn(this, other)
    class(modint), intent(inout) :: this
    class(*), intent(in) :: other
    integer(int64) :: val
    select type (other)
    type is (modint)
      this%val = other%val
    class default
      val = to_int64(other)
      if (0_8 <= val .and. val < modu) then
        this%val = val
      else
        this%val = modulo(val, modu)
      end if
    end select
  end
  pure elemental type(modint) function add(this, other) result(res)
    class(modint), intent(in) :: this
    class(*), intent(in) :: other
    integer(int64) :: val
    select type (other)
    type is (modint)
      if (0_8 <= this%val + other%val .and. this%val + other%val < modu) then
        res%val = this%val + other%val
      else
        res%val = this%val + other%val - modu
      end if
    class default
      val = to_int64(other)
      if (0_8 <= this%val + val .and. this%val + val < modu) then
        res%val = this%val + val
      else
        res%val = modulo(this%val + val, modu)
      end if
    end select
  end
  pure elemental type(modint) function sub(this, other) result(res)
    class(modint), intent(in) :: this
    class(*), intent(in) :: other
    integer(int64) :: val
    select type (other)
    type is (modint)
      if (0_8 <= this%val - other%val .and. this%val - other%val < modu) then
        res%val = this%val - other%val
      else
        res%val = this%val - other%val + modu
      end if
    class default
      val = to_int64(other)
      if (0_8 <= this%val - val .and. this%val - val < modu) then
        res%val = this%val - val
      else
        res%val = modulo(this%val - val, modu)
      end if
    end select
  end
  pure elemental type(modint) function mul(this, other) result(res)
    class(modint), intent(in) :: this
    class(*), intent(in) :: other
    integer(int64) :: val
    select type (other)
    type is (modint)
      val = other%val
    class default
      val = to_int64(other)
    end select
    if (0_8 <= this%val * val .and. this%val * val < modu) then
      res%val = this%val * val
    else
      res%val = modulo(this%val * val, modu)
    end if
  end
  pure elemental type(modint) function div(this,other) result(res)
    class(modint), intent(in) :: this
    class(*), intent(in) :: other
    type(modint) :: tmp
    call asgn(tmp, other)
    call asgn(res, mul(this, inv(tmp)))
  end
  pure elemental integer(int64) function get(this) result(res)
    class(modint), intent(in) :: this
    res = this%val
  end
  pure elemental type(modint) function inv(this) result(res)
    class(modint), intent(in) :: this
    integer(int64) :: a, b, c, n
    integer(int64) :: x, y, z, m
    a = this%val
    b = modu
    c = 0_8
    n = 1_8
    do while (b /= 0_8)
      x = b
      y = mod(a,b)
      z = n-a/b*c
      m = c
      a = x
      b = y
      c = z
      n = m
    end do
    call asgn(res,n)
  end
  pure elemental type(modint) function pow(this, other) result(res)
    class(modint), intent(in) :: this
    class(*), intent(in) :: other
    integer(int64) :: n
    type(modint) :: i
    res%val = 1
    i%val = this%val
    n = to_int64(other)
    do while (n > 0_8)
      if (btest(n, 0)) call asgn(res, mul(res, i))
      call asgn(i, mul(i, i))
      n = rshift(n, 1)
    end do
  end
  pure elemental type(modint) function add_r(other, this) result(res)
    class(modint), intent(in) :: this
    class(*), intent(in) :: other
    call asgn(res, add(this, other))
  end
  pure elemental type(modint) function sub_r(other, this) result(res)
    class(modint), intent(in) :: this
    class(*), intent(in) :: other
    call asgn(res, sub(this, other))
  end
  pure elemental type(modint) function mul_r(other, this) result(res)
    class(modint), intent(in) :: this
    class(*), intent(in) :: other
    call asgn(res, mul(this, other))
  end
  pure elemental type(modint) function div_r(other, this) result(res)
    class(modint), intent(in) :: this
    class(*), intent(in) :: other
    call asgn(res, div(this, other))
  end
  pure type(modint) function dot_prod(x, y) result(res)
    type(modint), intent(in) :: x(:), y(:)
    integer :: i
    if (size(x, 1) /= size(y, 1)) i = to_int64('')
    do i = 1, size(x,1)
      call asgn(res, add(res, mul(x(i), y(i))))
    end do
  end
  pure function matmul1(x, y) result(res)
    type(modint), intent(in) :: x(:, :), y(:)
    type(modint) :: res(size(x, 1))
    integer :: i
    do i = 1, size(x, 1)
      call asgn(res(i), dot_prod(x(i, :), y))
    end do
  end
  pure function matmul2(x, y) result(res)
    type(modint), intent(in) :: x(:), y(:, :)
    type(modint) :: res(size(y, 2))
    integer :: i
    do i = 1, size(y, 2)
      call asgn(res(i), dot_prod(x, y(:, i)))
    end do
  end
  pure function matmul3(x, y) result(res)
    type(modint), intent(in) :: x(:, :), y(:, :)
    type(modint) :: res(size(x, 1), size(y, 2))
    integer :: i
    do i = 1, size(x, 1)
      call asgn(res(i, :), matmul2(x(i, :), y))
    end do
  end
end module module_modint
module modulo_utils
  use module_modint
  implicit none
  type(modint), allocatable :: f(:), invf(:)
contains
  subroutine init(n)
    integer, intent(in) :: n
    integer :: i
    if (allocated(f)) deallocate(f)
    if (allocated(invf)) deallocate(invf)
    allocate(f(0:n), invf(0:n))
    f(0) = 1
    do i = 1, n
      f(i) = f(i-1) * i
    end do
    invf(n) = f(n)%inv()
    do i = n, 1, -1
      invf(i-1) = invf(i) * i
    end do
  end
  pure elemental type(modint) function perm(n, k) result(res)
    integer, intent(in) :: n, k
    if (k > n .or. n < 0 .or. k < 0) return
    res = f(n) * invf(n - k)
  end
  pure elemental type(modint) function comb(n, k) result(res)
    integer, intent(in) :: n, k
    res = perm(n, k) * invf(k)
  end
  pure elemental type(modint) function homo(n, k) result(res)
    integer, intent(in) :: n, k
    res = 1
    if (n == 0 .and. k == 0) return
    res = comb(n + k - 1, k)
  end
end module modulo_utils
program strivore
  use module_modint
  use modulo_utils
  implicit none
  integer :: k, n, i
  character(1000000) :: s
  type(modint) :: m
  read(*,*) k
  read(*,*) s
  n = len_trim(s)
  call init(n + k + 27)
  do i = 0, k
    m = m + modint(26) ** i * modint(25) ** (k - i) * homo(k - i + 1, n - 1)
  end do
  write(*,'(i0)') m%get()
end program strivore

data Mint (m :: Nat) = Mint {getMintValue :: Integer} deriving (Eq, Show)
 
getMintMod :: forall p. KnownNat p => Mint p -> Integer
getMintMod = natVal

makeMint :: forall p. KnownNat p => Integer -> Mint p
makeMint a = let r = Mint $ fromInteger $ a `mod` (getMintMod r) in r

instance KnownNat p => Num (Mint p) where
  (Mint a) + (Mint b) = makeMint $ a + b
  (Mint a) - (Mint b) = makeMint $ a - b
  (Mint a) * (Mint b) = makeMint $ a * b
  negate (Mint a) = makeMint $ negate a
  abs = id
  signum (Mint a) = if a == 0 then 0 else 1
  fromInteger = makeMint

invMint :: forall p. KnownNat p => Mint p -> Mint p
invMint m = let p = getMintMod m in m ^ (p - 2)

powerMint :: forall p. KnownNat p => Integer -> Integer -> Mint p
powerMint n p
  | p >= 0 = (fromInteger n :: Mint p) ^ p
  | otherwise = invMint $ powerMint n (-p)


type M = Mint 1000000007



data FactorialTable m =
  FactorialTable {fac :: V.Vector m, ifac :: V.Vector m} deriving Show

getFactorialTable :: forall p. KnownNat p => Int -> FactorialTable (Mint p)
getFactorialTable n = FactorialTable {fac = fac, ifac = ifac}
  where
    fac = V.scanl (*) 1 $ V.generate n (\i -> fromIntegral (i + 1))
    ifac =
      let x = invMint (fac V.! n)
      in V.reverse $ V.unfoldrN (n + 1) (\(b, k) -> let a = b * (fromIntegral k) in Just (b, (a, k - 1))) (x, n)


fP :: forall p. KnownNat p => FactorialTable (Mint p) -> Int -> Int -> Mint p
fP FactorialTable {fac = fac, ifac = ifac} n k
  | n < k || n < 0 || k < 0 = 0
  | otherwise = (fac V.! n) * (ifac V.! (n-k))

fC :: forall p. KnownNat p => FactorialTable (Mint p) -> Int -> Int -> Mint p
fC f@FactorialTable {fac = fac, ifac = ifac} n k
  | n < k || n < 0 || k < 0 = 0
  | otherwise = fP f n k * (ifac V.! k)

fH :: forall p. KnownNat p => FactorialTable (Mint p) -> Int -> Int -> Mint p
fH f n k
  | n == 0 && k == 0 = 1
  | otherwise = fC f (n + k - 1) k

perm :: Int -> Int -> IntMod

comb :: Int -> Int -> IntMod
comb n k = fact n * recipFact (n - k) * recipFact k
{-# INLINE comb #-}
factCacheSize :: Int
factCacheSize = min (modulus - 1) FACT_CACHE_SIZE
{-# INLINE factCacheSize #-}
factCache :: U.Vector IntMod
factCache = U.scanl' (\ x y -> x * coerce y) (1 :: IntMod) $ U.generate factCacheSize (+ 1)
{-# NOINLINE factCache #-}
recipFactCache :: U.Vector IntMod
recipFactCache = U.scanr' ((*) . coerce) (1 / factCache U.! factCacheSize) $ U.generate factCacheSize (+ 1)
{-# NOINLINE recipFactCache #-}

p = 10^9+7 :: Int

newtype Modulo = Modulo { getInt :: Int } deriving (Eq, Ord)

instance Num Modulo where
  Modulo a + Modulo b = Modulo ((a + b) `mod` p)
  Modulo a - Modulo b = Modulo ((a - b) `mod` p)
  Modulo a * Modulo b = Modulo ((a * b) `mod` p)
  abs = undefined
  signum = undefined
  fromInteger i = Modulo (fromIntegral i `mod` p)

instance Show Modulo where
  show (Modulo i) = show i

inv :: Modulo -> Modulo
inv 1 = 1
inv a = pwr a (p-2)

pwr :: Modulo -> Int -> Modulo
pwr !a !n
  | n == 0    = 1
  | odd n     = a*r
  | otherwise = r
  where
  q = pwr a (n `div` 2)
  r = q*q

fac :: Int -> Modulo
fac 0 = 1
fac n = Modulo n*fac (n-1)

fac' :: Int -> Int -> Modulo
fac' n 0 = Modulo 1
fac' n m = Modulo n*fac' (n-1) (m-1)

choose :: Int -> Int -> Modulo
choose n m = fac' n m' * inv (fac m')
  where 
  m' = min m (n-m)

remP = const Rem

{-# INLINE modulus32 #-}
modulus32 :: HasWord32 m => Rem m -> Word32
modulus32 x = word32Val $ proxyFor x

class HasWord32 m where
  word32Val :: Proxy m -> Word32

instance Show (Rem m) where
  {-# INLINE showsPrec #-}
  showsPrec = coerce `asTypeOf` (\f p (Rem v) -> f p v) $ showsPrec

negRem :: HasWord32 m => Rem m -> Rem m
{-# INLINE negRem #-}
negRem x0@(Rem x)
  | x == 0 = Rem 0
  | otherwise = Rem $ modulus32 x0 - x

addRem, subRem, multRem
  :: HasWord32 m => Rem m -> Rem m -> Rem m
{-# INLINE subRem #-}
subRem x0@(Rem x) (Rem y) = Rem $ x-y + if x < y then modulus32 x0 else 0
{-# INLINE addRem #-}
addRem x0@(Rem x) (Rem y) = Rem $ x-negy + if x < negy then m else 0
  where m = modulus32 x0; negy = m-y
{-# INLINE multRem #-}
multRem x0@(Rem x) (Rem y)
  = Rem $ toW32 $ (toW64 x * toW64 y) `rem` toW64 (modulus32 x0)

{-# INLINE fromIntegerRem #-}
fromIntegerRem :: (HasWord32 m) => Integer -> Rem m
fromIntegerRem x = withProxy $ Rem . fromInteger . mod x . toInteger . word32Val

{-# INLINE signumRem #-}
signumRem :: (HasWord32 m) => Rem m -> Rem m
signumRem = (\case True -> Rem 0; False -> Rem 1) . (== Rem 0)

instance HasWord32 m => Num (Rem m) where
  {-# INLINE negate #-}
  negate = negRem
  {-# INLINE (-) #-}
  (-) = subRem
  {-# INLINE (+) #-}
  (+) = addRem
  {-# INLINE (*) #-}
  (*) = multRem
  {-# INLINE fromInteger #-}
  fromInteger = fromIntegerRem
  {-# INLINE abs #-}
  abs = id
  {-# INLINE signum #-}
  signum = signumRem

recipRem :: HasWord32 m => Rem m -> Rem m
{-# INLINE recipRem #-}
recipRem = \x -> x ^ (modulus32 x - 2)

-- works only for primes
instance HasWord32 m => Fractional (Rem m) where
  {-# INLINE recip #-}
  recip = recipRem
  fromRational q = fromInteger (numerator q) / fromInteger (denominator q)

IL(showTupAsBuilderWith)
  :: (a -> BSB.Builder) -> (b -> BSB.Builder) -> (a,b) -> BSB.Builder
showTupAsBuilderWith showA showB
  = \(a,b) -> (showA a <>) $ BSB.char7 ' ' <> showB b
IL(showTupAsBuilder) :: (ShowAsBuilder a, ShowAsBuilder b)
  => (a,b) -> BSB.Builder
showTupAsBuilder = showTupAsBuilderWith showAsBuilder showAsBuilder 

IL(showTup3AsBuilderWith) :: (a -> BSB.Builder) -> (b -> BSB.Builder) ->
  (c -> BSB.Builder) -> (a,b,c) -> BSB.Builder
showTup3AsBuilderWith showA showB showC
  = \(a,b,c) -> (showA a <>) $ (BSB.char7 ' ' <>) $ (showB b <>)
                $ (BSB.char7 ' ' <>) $ showC c
IL(showTup3AsBuilder) :: (ShowAsBuilder a, ShowAsBuilder b, ShowAsBuilder c)
  => (a,b,c) -> BSB.Builder
showTup3AsBuilder
  = showTup3AsBuilderWith showAsBuilder showAsBuilder showAsBuilder

IL(showTup4AsBuilderWith) :: (a -> BSB.Builder) -> (b -> BSB.Builder) ->
  (c -> BSB.Builder) -> (d -> BSB.Builder) -> (a,b,c,d) -> BSB.Builder
showTup4AsBuilderWith showA showB showC showD
  = \(a,b,c,d) -> (showA a <>) $ (BSB.char7 ' ' <>)
                  $ showTup3AsBuilderWith showB showC showD (b,c,d)
IL(showTup4AsBuilder) ::
  (ShowAsBuilder a, ShowAsBuilder b, ShowAsBuilder c, ShowAsBuilder d) =>
  (a,b,c,d) -> BSB.Builder
showTup4AsBuilder = showTup4AsBuilderWith showAsBuilder showAsBuilder
                    showAsBuilder showAsBuilder

IL(vecToBuilder) :: (VG.Vector v a)
  => BS.ByteString -- ^ prefix
  -> BS.ByteString -- ^ separator
  -> BS.ByteString -- ^ postfix
  -> (a -> BSB.Builder) -- ^ show function
  -> v a -> BSB.Builder
vecToBuilder !prefix !separator !postfix
  = vecToBuilder_ (BSB.byteString prefix)
                  (BSB.byteString separator)
                  (BSB.byteString postfix)


IL(vecToBuilder_) :: (VG.Vector v a)
  => BSB.Builder -- ^ prefix
  -> BSB.Builder -- ^ separator
  -> BSB.Builder -- ^ postfix
  -> (a -> BSB.Builder) -- ^ show function
  -> v a -> BSB.Builder
vecToBuilder_ !prefix !separator !postfix showFct = \vec -> prefix <>
  VG.foldr
  (\ a rest !prefx -> prefx <> (showFct a <> rest separator))
  (const postfix) vec mempty

IL(vMapFoldl) :: (VG.Vector v b, VG.Vector v c) =>
  (a -> b -> (c,a)) -> a -> v b -> v c
vMapFoldl f a
  = VG.unstream . VFB.inplace (streamMapFoldl f a) id . VG.stream

streamMapFoldl :: (Functor m) =>
  (a -> b -> (c,a)) -> a -> VFSM.Stream m b -> VFSM.Stream m c
{-# INLINE_FUSED streamMapFoldl #-}
streamMapFoldl f a (VFSM.Stream step s) = VFSM.Stream step1 (a,s)
  where
    {-# INLINE_INNER step1 #-}
    step1 (a0,s0) =  (<$> step s0) $ \r -> case r of
      VFSM.Yield b s1 -> case f a0 b of (c,a1) -> VFSM.Yield c (a1,s1)
      VFSM.Skip    s1 -> VFSM.Skip (a0,s1)
      VFSM.Done       -> VFSM.Done

  where (ptr, len) = VS.unsafeToForeignPtr0 vec

  (foldl1', generate, prescanl', prescanr', replicate, reverse, zipWith4)
import Prelude hiding (replicate, reverse)

main = print =<< sol <$> readLn <*> (C.length <$> C.getLine)

sol k n = foldl1' (.+.) $ zipWith4 (\a b c d -> a .*. b .*. c .*. d) c1 c2 p1 p2
  where
  c1 = prescanl' (.*.) (fac (n-1)) $ generate (k+1) (n+)
  c2 = prescanr' (.*.) (inv $ fac (n-1)*fac k) $ generate (k+1) id
  p1 = prescanl' (.*.) 1 $ replicate (k+1) 25
  p2 = reverse . prescanl' (.*.) 1 $ replicate (k+1) 26

(.*.) = ((`mod` p) .) . (*)
(.+.) = ((`mod` p) .) . (+)

p = 10^9+7 :: Int

inv 1 = 1
inv !a = pwr a (p-2)

pwr !a !n
  | n == 0    = 1
  | odd n     = a .*. r
  | otherwise = r
  where
  q = pwr a (n `div` 2)
  r = q .*. q

fac 0 = 1
fac !n = n .*. fac (n-1)

  l <- BS.length <$> BS.getLine
  print $ VU.sum
    $ VU.zipWith (*) (VU.iterateN (k+1) (*(remF 25/remF 26)) (remF 26^k))

comb :: Int -> Int -> RemF
comb n k | n < 0 || k < 0 || k > n = 0
         | otherwise = facto n * factoInv (n-k) * factoInv k

         $ VU.generate 2_000_001 fromIntegral

  VU.map (Rem . fromIntegral) $ VU.generate 2_000_000 (2_000_000-)

modulus32 :: HasWord32 m => Rem m -> Word32

class HasWord32 m where
  word32Val :: Proxy m -> Word32

instance Show (Rem m) where
  {-# INLINE showsPrec #-}
  showsPrec = coerce `asTypeOf` (\f p (Rem v) -> f p v) $ showsPrec

negRem :: HasWord32 m => Rem m -> Rem m
{-# INLINE negRem #-}
negRem x0@(Rem x)
  | x == 0 = Rem 0
  | otherwise = Rem $ modulus32 x0 - x

addRem, subRem, multRem
  :: HasWord32 m => Rem m -> Rem m -> Rem m
{-# INLINE subRem #-}
subRem x0@(Rem x) (Rem y) = Rem $ x-y + if x < y then modulus32 x0 else 0
{-# INLINE addRem #-}
addRem x0@(Rem x) (Rem y) = Rem $ x-negy + if x < negy then m else 0
  where m = modulus32 x0; negy = m-y
{-# INLINE multRem #-}
multRem x0@(Rem x) (Rem y)
  = Rem $ toW32 $ (toW64 x * toW64 y) `rem` toW64 (modulus32 x0)

{-# INLINE fromIntegerRem #-}
fromIntegerRem :: (HasWord32 m) => Integer -> Rem m
fromIntegerRem x = withProxy $ Rem . fromInteger . mod x . toInteger . word32Val

{-# INLINE signumRem #-}
signumRem :: (HasWord32 m) => Rem m -> Rem m
signumRem = (\case True -> Rem 0; False -> Rem 1) . (== Rem 0)

instance HasWord32 m => Num (Rem m) where
  {-# INLINE negate #-}
  negate = negRem
  {-# INLINE (-) #-}
  (-) = subRem
  {-# INLINE (+) #-}
  (+) = addRem
  {-# INLINE (*) #-}
  (*) = multRem
  {-# INLINE fromInteger #-}
  fromInteger = fromIntegerRem
  {-# INLINE abs #-}
  abs = id
  {-# INLINE signum #-}
  signum = signumRem

recipRem :: HasWord32 m => Rem m -> Rem m
{-# INLINE recipRem #-}
recipRem = \x -> x ^ (modulus32 x - 2)

-- works only for primes
instance HasWord32 m => Fractional (Rem m) where
  {-# INLINE recip #-}
  recip = recipRem
  fromRational q = fromInteger (numerator q) / fromInteger (denominator q)

IL(showTupAsBuilderWith)
  :: (a -> BSB.Builder) -> (b -> BSB.Builder) -> (a,b) -> BSB.Builder
showTupAsBuilderWith showA showB
  = \(a,b) -> (showA a <>) $ BSB.char7 ' ' <> showB b
IL(showTupAsBuilder) :: (ShowAsBuilder a, ShowAsBuilder b)
  => (a,b) -> BSB.Builder
showTupAsBuilder = showTupAsBuilderWith showAsBuilder showAsBuilder 

IL(showTup3AsBuilderWith) :: (a -> BSB.Builder) -> (b -> BSB.Builder) ->
  (c -> BSB.Builder) -> (a,b,c) -> BSB.Builder
showTup3AsBuilderWith showA showB showC
  = \(a,b,c) -> (showA a <>) $ (BSB.char7 ' ' <>) $ (showB b <>)
                $ (BSB.char7 ' ' <>) $ showC c
IL(showTup3AsBuilder) :: (ShowAsBuilder a, ShowAsBuilder b, ShowAsBuilder c)
  => (a,b,c) -> BSB.Builder
showTup3AsBuilder
  = showTup3AsBuilderWith showAsBuilder showAsBuilder showAsBuilder

IL(showTup4AsBuilderWith) :: (a -> BSB.Builder) -> (b -> BSB.Builder) ->
  (c -> BSB.Builder) -> (d -> BSB.Builder) -> (a,b,c,d) -> BSB.Builder
showTup4AsBuilderWith showA showB showC showD
  = \(a,b,c,d) -> (showA a <>) $ (BSB.char7 ' ' <>)
                  $ showTup3AsBuilderWith showB showC showD (b,c,d)
IL(showTup4AsBuilder) ::
  (ShowAsBuilder a, ShowAsBuilder b, ShowAsBuilder c, ShowAsBuilder d) =>
  (a,b,c,d) -> BSB.Builder
showTup4AsBuilder = showTup4AsBuilderWith showAsBuilder showAsBuilder
                    showAsBuilder showAsBuilder

IL(vecToBuilder) :: (VG.Vector v a)
  => BS.ByteString -- ^ prefix
  -> BS.ByteString -- ^ separator
  -> BS.ByteString -- ^ postfix
  -> (a -> BSB.Builder) -- ^ show function
  -> v a -> BSB.Builder
vecToBuilder !prefix !separator !postfix
  = vecToBuilder_ (BSB.byteString prefix)
                  (BSB.byteString separator)
                  (BSB.byteString postfix)


IL(vecToBuilder_) :: (VG.Vector v a)
  => BSB.Builder -- ^ prefix
  -> BSB.Builder -- ^ separator
  -> BSB.Builder -- ^ postfix
  -> (a -> BSB.Builder) -- ^ show function
  -> v a -> BSB.Builder
vecToBuilder_ !prefix !separator !postfix showFct = \vec -> prefix <>
  VG.foldr
  (\ a rest !prefx -> prefx <> (showFct a <> rest separator))
  (const postfix) vec mempty

streamMapFoldl :: (Functor m) =>
  (a -> b -> (c,a)) -> a -> VFSM.Stream m b -> VFSM.Stream m c
{-# INLINE_FUSED streamMapFoldl #-}
streamMapFoldl f a (VFSM.Stream step s) = VFSM.Stream step1 (a,s)
  where
    {-# INLINE_INNER step1 #-}
    step1 (a0,s0) =  (<$> step s0) $ \r -> case r of
      VFSM.Yield b s1 -> case f a0 b of (c,a1) -> VFSM.Yield c (a1,s1)
      VFSM.Skip    s1 -> VFSM.Skip (a0,s1)
      VFSM.Done       -> VFSM.Done

data Mint (m :: Nat) = Mint {getMintValue :: !Int} deriving (Eq, Show)
 
getMintMod :: forall p. KnownNat p => Mint p -> Int
getMintMod = fromInteger . natVal

makeMint :: forall p. KnownNat p => Int -> Mint p
makeMint a = let r = Mint $ a `mod` (getMintMod r) in r

instance KnownNat p => Num (Mint p) where
  (Mint a) + (Mint b) = makeMint $ a + b
  (Mint a) - (Mint b) = makeMint $ a - b
  (Mint a) * (Mint b) = makeMint $ a * b
  negate (Mint a) = makeMint $ negate a
  abs = id
  signum (Mint a) = if a == 0 then 0 else 1
  fromInteger = makeMint . fromIntegral

invMint :: forall p. KnownNat p => Mint p -> Mint p
invMint m = let p = getMintMod m in m ^ (p - 2)

powerMint :: forall p. KnownNat p => Int -> Integer -> Mint p
powerMint n p
  | p >= 0 = (makeMint n :: Mint p) ^ p
  | otherwise = invMint $ powerMint n (-p)


type M = Mint 1000000007



data FactorialTable m =
  FactorialTable {fac :: V.Vector m, ifac :: V.Vector m} deriving Show

getFactorialTable :: forall p. KnownNat p => Int -> FactorialTable (Mint p)
getFactorialTable n = FactorialTable {fac = fac, ifac = ifac}
  where
    fac = V.scanl (*) 1 $ V.generate n (\i -> fromIntegral (i + 1))
    ifac =
      let x = invMint (fac V.! n)
      in V.reverse $ V.unfoldrN (n + 1) (\(b, k) -> let a = b * (fromIntegral k) in Just (b, (a, k - 1))) (x, n)


fP :: forall p. KnownNat p => FactorialTable (Mint p) -> Int -> Int -> Mint p
fP FactorialTable {fac = fac, ifac = ifac} n k
  | n < k || n < 0 || k < 0 = 0
  | otherwise = (fac V.! n) * (ifac V.! (n-k))

fC :: forall p. KnownNat p => FactorialTable (Mint p) -> Int -> Int -> Mint p
fC f@FactorialTable {fac = fac, ifac = ifac} n k
  | n < k || n < 0 || k < 0 = 0
  | otherwise = fP f n k * (ifac V.! k)

fH :: forall p. KnownNat p => FactorialTable (Mint p) -> Int -> Int -> Mint p
fH f n k
  | n == 0 && k == 0 = 1
  | otherwise = fC f (n + k - 1) k

class HasWord32 m where

instance Show (Rem m) where
  {-# INLINE showsPrec #-}
  showsPrec = coerce `asTypeOf` (\f p (Rem v) -> f p v) $ showsPrec

negRem :: HasWord32 m => Rem m -> Rem m
{-# INLINE negRem #-}
negRem x0@(Rem x)
  | x == 0 = Rem 0
  | otherwise = Rem $ modulus32 x0 - x

addRem, subRem, multRem
  :: HasWord32 m => Rem m -> Rem m -> Rem m
{-# INLINE subRem #-}
subRem x0@(Rem x) (Rem y) = Rem $ x-y + if x < y then modulus32 x0 else 0
{-# INLINE addRem #-}
addRem x0@(Rem x) (Rem y) = Rem $ x-negy + if x < negy then m else 0
  where m = modulus32 x0; negy = m-y
{-# INLINE multRem #-}
multRem x0@(Rem x) (Rem y)
  = Rem $ toW32 $ (toW64 x * toW64 y) `rem` toW64 (modulus32 x0)

{-# INLINE fromIntegerRem #-}
fromIntegerRem :: (HasWord32 m) => Integer -> Rem m
fromIntegerRem x = withProxy $ Rem . fromInteger . mod x . toInteger . word32Val

{-# INLINE signumRem #-}
signumRem :: (HasWord32 m) => Rem m -> Rem m
signumRem = (\case True -> Rem 0; False -> Rem 1) . (== Rem 0)

instance HasWord32 m => Num (Rem m) where
  {-# INLINE negate #-}
  negate = negRem
  {-# INLINE (-) #-}
  (-) = subRem
  {-# INLINE (+) #-}
  (+) = addRem
  {-# INLINE (*) #-}
  (*) = multRem
  {-# INLINE fromInteger #-}
  fromInteger = fromIntegerRem
  {-# INLINE abs #-}
  abs = id
  {-# INLINE signum #-}
  signum = signumRem

recipRem :: HasWord32 m => Rem m -> Rem m
{-# INLINE recipRem #-}
recipRem = \x -> x ^ (modulus32 x - 2)

-- works only for primes
instance HasWord32 m => Fractional (Rem m) where
  {-# INLINE recip #-}
  recip = recipRem
  fromRational q = fromInteger (numerator q) / fromInteger (denominator q)

IL(showTupAsBuilderWith)
  :: (a -> BSB.Builder) -> (b -> BSB.Builder) -> (a,b) -> BSB.Builder
showTupAsBuilderWith showA showB
  = \(a,b) -> (showA a <>) $ BSB.char7 ' ' <> showB b
IL(showTupAsBuilder) :: (ShowAsBuilder a, ShowAsBuilder b)
  => (a,b) -> BSB.Builder
showTupAsBuilder = showTupAsBuilderWith showAsBuilder showAsBuilder 

IL(showTup3AsBuilderWith) :: (a -> BSB.Builder) -> (b -> BSB.Builder) ->
  (c -> BSB.Builder) -> (a,b,c) -> BSB.Builder
showTup3AsBuilderWith showA showB showC
  = \(a,b,c) -> (showA a <>) $ (BSB.char7 ' ' <>) $ (showB b <>)
                $ (BSB.char7 ' ' <>) $ showC c
IL(showTup3AsBuilder) :: (ShowAsBuilder a, ShowAsBuilder b, ShowAsBuilder c)
  => (a,b,c) -> BSB.Builder
showTup3AsBuilder
  = showTup3AsBuilderWith showAsBuilder showAsBuilder showAsBuilder

IL(showTup4AsBuilderWith) :: (a -> BSB.Builder) -> (b -> BSB.Builder) ->
  (c -> BSB.Builder) -> (d -> BSB.Builder) -> (a,b,c,d) -> BSB.Builder
showTup4AsBuilderWith showA showB showC showD
  = \(a,b,c,d) -> (showA a <>) $ (BSB.char7 ' ' <>)
                  $ showTup3AsBuilderWith showB showC showD (b,c,d)
IL(showTup4AsBuilder) ::
  (ShowAsBuilder a, ShowAsBuilder b, ShowAsBuilder c, ShowAsBuilder d) =>
  (a,b,c,d) -> BSB.Builder
showTup4AsBuilder = showTup4AsBuilderWith showAsBuilder showAsBuilder
                    showAsBuilder showAsBuilder

  => (a -> BSB.Builder) -- ^ show function
  -> v a -> BSB.Builder
IL(v2BSpcSepLnWith) = v2BSpcSepPostfWith $ BS.singleton '\n'
IL(v2BSpcSepWith) = v2BSpcSepPostfWith BS.empty
IL(v2BConcatWith) showFct = VG.foldr ((<>) . showFct) mempty
IL(v2BLinesWith) showFct
  = VG.foldr (\ a -> (showFct a <>) . (BSB.char7 '\n' <>)) mempty


v2BSpcSepPostf :: (VG.Vector v a, ShowAsBuilder a)
  => BS.ByteString -- ^ postfix
  -> v a -> BSB.Builder
IL(v2BSpcSepPostf) = (`v2BSpcSepPostfWith` showAsBuilder)

v2BSpcSepPostfWith :: (VG.Vector v a)
  => BS.ByteString -- ^ postfix
  -> (a -> BSB.Builder) -- ^ show function
  -> v a -> BSB.Builder
IL(v2BSpcSepPostfWith) = vecToBuilder BS.empty $ BS.singleton ' '

IL(vecToBuilder) :: (VG.Vector v a)
  => BS.ByteString -- ^ prefix
  -> BS.ByteString -- ^ separator
  -> BS.ByteString -- ^ postfix
  -> (a -> BSB.Builder) -- ^ show function
  -> v a -> BSB.Builder
vecToBuilder !prefix !separator !postfix
  = vecToBuilder_ (BSB.byteString prefix)
                  (BSB.byteString separator)
                  (BSB.byteString postfix)


IL(vecToBuilder_) :: (VG.Vector v a)
  => BSB.Builder -- ^ prefix
  -> BSB.Builder -- ^ separator
  -> BSB.Builder -- ^ postfix
  -> (a -> BSB.Builder) -- ^ show function
  -> v a -> BSB.Builder
vecToBuilder_ !prefix !separator !postfix showFct = \vec -> prefix <>
  VG.foldr
  (\ a rest !prefx -> prefx <> (showFct a <> rest separator))
  (const postfix) vec mempty

IL(vMapFoldl) :: (VG.Vector v b, VG.Vector v c) =>
  (a -> b -> (c,a)) -> a -> v b -> v c
vMapFoldl f a
  = VG.unstream . VFB.inplace (streamMapFoldl f a) id . VG.stream

streamMapFoldl :: (Functor m) =>
  (a -> b -> (c,a)) -> a -> VFSM.Stream m b -> VFSM.Stream m c
{-# INLINE_FUSED streamMapFoldl #-}
streamMapFoldl f a (VFSM.Stream step s) = VFSM.Stream step1 (a,s)
  where
    {-# INLINE_INNER step1 #-}
    step1 (a0,s0) =  (<$> step s0) $ \r -> case r of
      VFSM.Yield b s1 -> case f a0 b of (c,a1) -> VFSM.Yield c (a1,s1)
      VFSM.Skip    s1 -> VFSM.Skip (a0,s1)
      VFSM.Done       -> VFSM.Done

IL(svecToBS) :: VS.Vector Word8 -> BS.ByteString

  where (ptr, len) = VS.unsafeToForeignPtr0 vec

newtype Magic r = Magic (forall (m :: *). HasWord32 m => Proxy m -> r)

{-# INLINE reifyWord32 #-}
reifyWord32 :: forall a. Word32 ->
  (forall (m :: *). HasWord32 m => Proxy m -> a) -> a
reifyWord32 v f = unsafeCoerce (Magic f :: Magic a) (const v) Proxy

newtype Rem m = Rem {unRem :: Word32} deriving (Eq)

withTypeArgOf :: c a -> d a -> c a
{-# INLINE CONLIKE withTypeArgOf #-}
withTypeArgOf = const

proxyFor :: c a -> Proxy a
{-# INLINE CONLIKE proxyFor #-}
proxyFor = const Proxy

withProxy :: (Proxy m -> c m) -> c m
{-# INLINE withProxy #-}
withProxy f = f Proxy

remP :: Proxy m -> Word32 -> Rem m
{-# INLINE CONLIKE remP #-}
remP = const Rem

{-# INLINE modulus32 #-}
modulus32 :: HasWord32 m => Rem m -> Word32
modulus32 x = word32Val $ proxyFor x

class HasWord32 m where
  word32Val :: Proxy m -> Word32

instance Show (Rem m) where
  {-# INLINE showsPrec #-}
  showsPrec = coerce `asTypeOf` (\f p (Rem v) -> f p v) $ showsPrec

negRem :: HasWord32 m => Rem m -> Rem m
{-# INLINE negRem #-}
negRem x0@(Rem x)
  | x == 0 = Rem 0
  | otherwise = Rem $ modulus32 x0 - x

addRem, subRem, multRem
  :: HasWord32 m => Rem m -> Rem m -> Rem m
{-# INLINE subRem #-}
subRem x0@(Rem x) (Rem y) = Rem $ x-y + if x < y then modulus32 x0 else 0
{-# INLINE addRem #-}
addRem x0@(Rem x) (Rem y) = Rem $ x-negy + if x < negy then m else 0
  where m = modulus32 x0; negy = m-y
{-# INLINE multRem #-}
multRem x0@(Rem x) (Rem y)
  = Rem $ toW32 $ (toW64 x * toW64 y) `rem` toW64 (modulus32 x0)

{-# INLINE fromIntegerRem #-}
fromIntegerRem :: (HasWord32 m) => Integer -> Rem m
fromIntegerRem x = withProxy $ Rem . fromInteger . mod x . toInteger . word32Val

{-# INLINE signumRem #-}
signumRem :: (HasWord32 m) => Rem m -> Rem m
signumRem = (\case True -> Rem 0; False -> Rem 1) . (== Rem 0)

instance HasWord32 m => Num (Rem m) where
  {-# INLINE negate #-}
  negate = negRem
  {-# INLINE (-) #-}
  (-) = subRem
  {-# INLINE (+) #-}
  (+) = addRem
  {-# INLINE (*) #-}
  (*) = multRem
  {-# INLINE fromInteger #-}
  fromInteger = fromIntegerRem
  {-# INLINE abs #-}
  abs = id
  {-# INLINE signum #-}
  signum = signumRem

recipRem :: HasWord32 m => Rem m -> Rem m
{-# INLINE recipRem #-}
recipRem = \x -> x ^ (modulus32 x - 2)

-- works only for primes
instance HasWord32 m => Fractional (Rem m) where
  {-# INLINE recip #-}
  recip = recipRem
  fromRational q = fromInteger (numerator q) / fromInteger (denominator q)

  {-# INLINE basicUnsafeThaw #-}

IL(showTupAsBuilderWith)
  :: (a -> BSB.Builder) -> (b -> BSB.Builder) -> (a,b) -> BSB.Builder
showTupAsBuilderWith showA showB
  = \(a,b) -> (showA a <>) $ BSB.char7 ' ' <> showB b
IL(showTupAsBuilder) :: (ShowAsBuilder a, ShowAsBuilder b)
  => (a,b) -> BSB.Builder
showTupAsBuilder = showTupAsBuilderWith showAsBuilder showAsBuilder 

IL(showTup3AsBuilderWith) :: (a -> BSB.Builder) -> (b -> BSB.Builder) ->
  (c -> BSB.Builder) -> (a,b,c) -> BSB.Builder
showTup3AsBuilderWith showA showB showC
  = \(a,b,c) -> (showA a <>) $ (BSB.char7 ' ' <>) $ (showB b <>)
                $ (BSB.char7 ' ' <>) $ showC c
IL(showTup3AsBuilder) :: (ShowAsBuilder a, ShowAsBuilder b, ShowAsBuilder c)
  => (a,b,c) -> BSB.Builder
showTup3AsBuilder
  = showTup3AsBuilderWith showAsBuilder showAsBuilder showAsBuilder

IL(showTup4AsBuilderWith) :: (a -> BSB.Builder) -> (b -> BSB.Builder) ->
  (c -> BSB.Builder) -> (d -> BSB.Builder) -> (a,b,c,d) -> BSB.Builder
showTup4AsBuilderWith showA showB showC showD
  = \(a,b,c,d) -> (showA a <>) $ (BSB.char7 ' ' <>)
                  $ showTup3AsBuilderWith showB showC showD (b,c,d)
IL(showTup4AsBuilder) ::
  (ShowAsBuilder a, ShowAsBuilder b, ShowAsBuilder c, ShowAsBuilder d) =>
  (a,b,c,d) -> BSB.Builder
showTup4AsBuilder = showTup4AsBuilderWith showAsBuilder showAsBuilder
                    showAsBuilder showAsBuilder

data Mint (m :: Nat) = Mint {getMintValue :: !Int} deriving (Eq, Show)
 
getMintMod :: forall p. KnownNat p => Mint p -> Int
getMintMod = fromInteger . natVal

makeMint :: forall p. KnownNat p => Int -> Mint p
makeMint a = let r = Mint $ a `mod` (getMintMod r) in r

instance KnownNat p => Num (Mint p) where
  (Mint a) + (Mint b) = makeMint $ a + b
  (Mint a) - (Mint b) = makeMint $ a - b
  (Mint a) * (Mint b) = makeMint $ a * b
  negate (Mint a) = makeMint $ negate a
  abs = id
  signum (Mint a) = if a == 0 then 0 else 1
  fromInteger = makeMint . fromIntegral

invMint :: forall p. KnownNat p => Mint p -> Mint p
invMint m = let p = getMintMod m in m ^ (p - 2)

powerMint :: forall p. KnownNat p => Int -> Integer -> Mint p
powerMint n p
  | p >= 0 = (makeMint n :: Mint p) ^ p
  | otherwise = invMint $ powerMint n (-p)


type M = Mint 1000000007



data FactorialTable m =
  FactorialTable {fac :: V.Vector m, ifac :: V.Vector m} deriving Show

getFactorialTable :: forall p. KnownNat p => Int -> FactorialTable (Mint p)
getFactorialTable n = FactorialTable {fac = fac, ifac = ifac}
  where
    fac = V.scanl (*) 1 $ V.generate n (\i -> fromIntegral (i + 1))
    ifac =
      let x = invMint (fac V.! n)
      in V.reverse $ V.unfoldrN (n + 1) (\(b, k) -> let a = b * (fromIntegral k) in Just (b, (a, k - 1))) (x, n)


fP :: forall p. KnownNat p => FactorialTable (Mint p) -> Int -> Int -> Mint p
fP FactorialTable {fac = fac, ifac = ifac} n k
  | n < k || n < 0 || k < 0 = 0
  | otherwise = (fac V.! n) * (ifac V.! (n-k))

fC :: forall p. KnownNat p => FactorialTable (Mint p) -> Int -> Int -> Mint p
fC f@FactorialTable {fac = fac, ifac = ifac} n k
  | n < k || n < 0 || k < 0 = 0
  | otherwise = fP f n k * (ifac V.! k)

fH :: forall p. KnownNat p => FactorialTable (Mint p) -> Int -> Int -> Mint p
fH f n k
  | n == 0 && k == 0 = 1
  | otherwise = fC f (n + k - 1) k

        (powerMint 26 (fromIntegral (k-i)) :: M) *
        fH f n i
    ) [0..k]

{-# INLINE (+%) #-}

(I# x#) -% (I# y#) = case x# -# y# of { r# -> I# (r# +# ((r# <# 0#) *# MOD#))}

(/%) :: Int -> Int -> Int
(I# x#) /% (I# y#) = go# y# MOD# 1# 0# where { go# a# b# u# v# | isTrue# (b# ># 0#) = case a# `quotInt#` b# of { q# -> go# b# (a# -# (q# *# b#)) v# (u# -# (q# *# v#))} | otherwise = I# ((x# *# (u# +# MOD#)) `remInt#` MOD#)}

x ^% n | n > 0 = go 1 x n | n == 0 = 1 | otherwise = go 1 (1 /% x) (-n) where { go !acc !y !m | m .&. 1 == 0 = go acc (y *% y) (unsafeShiftR m 1) | m == 1 = acc *% y | otherwise = go (acc *% y) (y *% y) (unsafeShiftR (m - 1) 1)}

fact :: Int -> IntMod
fact = U.unsafeIndex factCache
{-# INLINE fact #-}
recipFact :: Int -> IntMod
recipFact = U.unsafeIndex recipFactCache
{-# INLINE recipFact #-}
perm :: Int -> Int -> IntMod
perm n k = fact n * recipFact k
{-# INLINE perm #-}
comb :: Int -> Int -> IntMod
comb n k = fact n * recipFact (n - k) * recipFact k
{-# INLINE comb #-}
factCacheSize :: Int
factCacheSize = min (modulus - 1) FACT_CACHE_SIZE
{-# INLINE factCacheSize #-}
factCache :: U.Vector IntMod
factCache = U.scanl' (\ x y -> x * coerce y) (1 :: IntMod) $ U.generate factCacheSize (+ 1)
{-# NOINLINE factCache #-}
recipFactCache :: U.Vector IntMod
recipFactCache = U.scanr' ((*) . coerce) (1 / factCache U.! factCacheSize) $ U.generate factCacheSize (+ 1)
{-# NOINLINE recipFactCache #-}

moduloN :: Int
moduloN = 10 ^ 9 + 7

modN = flip mod moduloN

plusMod x y = modN $ x + y

minusMod x y | x < y = moduloN + x - y
             | otherwise = x - y

mulMod x y = modN $ x * y

powerMod x 0 = 1
powerMod x y
    | even y = mulMod t t
    | otherwise = mulMod x $ mulMod t t
    where
        t = powerMod x $ div y 2

invMod n = powerMod n $ moduloN - 2

finv :: Int -> Int
finv k = finvs V.! k
    where finvs :: V.Vector Int
          finvs = V.generate (10 ^ 6 + 1) finv'
              where finv' 0 = 1
                    finv' n = modN $ finvs V.! (n - 1) * inv n

inv :: Int -> Int
inv k = invs V.! k
    where inv' 1 = 1
          inv' n = modN (-(invs V.! r) * q)
              where (q, r) = moduloN `divMod` n
          invs :: V.Vector Int
          invs = V.generate (10 ^ 6 + 1) inv'

fact :: Int -> Int
fact k = facts V.! k
    where fact' 0 = 1
          fact' n = modN $ n * (facts V.! (n - 1))
          facts :: V.Vector Int
          facts = V.generate (10 ^ 6 + 1) fact'

comb :: Int -> Int -> Int
comb n k | n < 0 || k < 0 || n < k = 0
         | otherwise = modN $ modN (fact n * finv k) * finv (n - k)

function solve(k, n)

  for i in 1:n
    ans -= comb[i] * powermod(25, n + k - i + 1, MOD)
    ans = mod1(ans, MOD)
  end
  return ans
end

(declaim (inline mod-power))
(defun mod-power (base power modulus)
  "BASE := integer
POWER, MODULUS := non-negative fixnum"
  (declare ((integer 0 #.most-positive-fixnum) modulus power)
           (integer base))
  (let ((base (mod base modulus))
        (res (mod 1 modulus)))
    (declare ((integer 0 #.most-positive-fixnum) base res))
    (loop while (> power 0)
          when (oddp power)
          do (setq res (mod (* res base) modulus))
          do (setq base (mod (* base base) modulus)
                   power (ash power -1)))
    res))

(declaim ((simple-array (unsigned-byte 31) (*)) *fact* *fact-inv* *inv*))

(defparameter *fact-inv* (make-array +binom-size+ :element-type '(unsigned-byte 31))
  "table of inverses of factorials")

(defun initialize-binom ()
  (declare (optimize (speed 3) (safety 0)))
  (setf (aref *fact* 0) 1
        (aref *fact* 1) 1
        (aref *fact-inv* 0) 1
        (aref *fact-inv* 1) 1
        (aref *inv* 1) 1)
  (loop for i from 2 below +binom-size+
        do (setf (aref *fact* i) (mod (* i (aref *fact* (- i 1))) +binom-mod+)
                 (aref *inv* i) (- +binom-mod+
                                   (mod (* (aref *inv* (rem +binom-mod+ i))
                                           (floor +binom-mod+ i))
                                        +binom-mod+))
                 (aref *fact-inv* i) (mod (* (aref *inv* i)
                                             (aref *fact-inv* (- i 1)))
                                          +binom-mod+))))

(declaim (inline binom))
(defun binom (n k)
  "Returns nCk."
  (if (or (< n k) (< n 0) (< k 0))
      0
      (mod (* (aref *fact* n)
              (mod (* (aref *fact-inv* k) (aref *fact-inv* (- n k))) +binom-mod+))
           +binom-mod+)))

(declaim (inline perm))
(defun perm (n k)
  "Returns nPk."
  (if (or (< n k) (< n 0) (< k 0))
      0
      (mod (* (aref *fact* n) (aref *fact-inv* (- n k))) +binom-mod+)))

(declaim (inline multinomial))
(defun multinomial (&rest ks)
  "Returns the multinomial coefficient K!/k_1!k_2!...k_n! for K = k_1 + k_2 +
... + k_n. K must be equal to or smaller than
MOST-POSITIVE-FIXNUM. (multinomial) returns 1."
  (let ((sum 0)
        (result 1))
    (declare ((integer 0 #.most-positive-fixnum) result sum))
    (dolist (k ks)
      (incf sum k)
      (setq result
            (mod (* result (aref *fact-inv* k)) +binom-mod+)))
    (mod (* result (aref *fact* sum)) +binom-mod+)))

(declaim (inline stirling2))
(defun stirling2 (n k)
  "Returns the stirling number of the second kind S2(n, k). Time complexity is
O(klog(n))."
  (declare ((integer 0 #.most-positive-fixnum) n k))
  (labels ((mod-power (base exp)
             (declare ((integer 0 #.most-positive-fixnum) base exp))
             (loop with res of-type (integer 0 #.most-positive-fixnum) = 1
                   while (> exp 0)
                   when (oddp exp)
                   do (setq res (mod (* res base) +binom-mod+))
                   do (setq base (mod (* base base) +binom-mod+)
                            exp (ash exp -1))
                   finally (return res))))
    (loop with result of-type fixnum = 0
          for i from 0 to k
          for delta = (mod (* (binom k i) (mod-power i n)) +binom-mod+)
          when (evenp (- k i))
          do (incf result delta)
             (when (>= result +binom-mod+)
               (decf result +binom-mod+))
          else
          do (decf result delta)
             (when (< result 0)
               (incf result +binom-mod+))
          finally (return (mod (* result (aref *fact-inv* k)) +binom-mod+)))))

(declaim (inline catalan))
(defun catalan (n)
  "Returns the N-th Catalan number."
  (declare ((integer 0 #.most-positive-fixnum) n))
  (mod (* (aref *fact* (* 2 n))
          (mod (* (aref *fact-inv* (+ n 1))
                  (aref *fact-inv* n))
               +binom-mod+))
       +binom-mod+))

class Integer
  def factorial
    return 1 if self.zero?
    (1..self).inject(:*)
  end

  def permutation(k)
    return 1 if k.zero?
    (self - k + 1..self).inject(:*)
  end

  def combination(k)
    return 1 if k.zero?
    k = self - k if self - k < k
    self.permutation(k) / k.factorial
  end
end

def extended_gcd(a, b)
  last_remainder, remainder = a.abs, b.abs
  x, last_x, y, last_y = 0, 1, 1, 0
  while remainder != 0
    last_remainder, (quotient, remainder) = remainder, last_remainder.divmod(remainder)
    x, last_x = last_x - quotient*x, x
    y, last_y = last_y - quotient*y, y
  end
  return last_remainder, last_x * (a < 0 ? -1 : 1)
end

def invmod(e)
  g, x = extended_gcd(e, M)
  x % M
end

function init($max)
{
    global $fac, $finv, $inv;
    $fac = $finv = [1, 1];
    $inv[1] = 1;
    for ($i = 2; $i <= $max; ++$i) {
        $fac[$i] = $fac[$i - 1] * $i % MOD;
        $inv[$i] = MOD - $inv[MOD % $i] * intdiv(MOD, $i) % MOD;
        $finv[$i] = $finv[$i - 1] * $inv[$i] % MOD;
    }
}

// 組み合わせ(前処理利用）
function nCr2($n, $r)
{
    global $fac, $finv;
    $r = min($r, $n - $r);
    if ($r === 0) return 1;
    return $fac[$n] * ($finv[$r] * $finv[$n - $r] % MOD) % MOD;
}

Scanf.scanf "%d %s" (fun k s ->

    let z = 1_000_000_007 in
    let extgcd x y =
        let rec eg r0 r1 a0 a1 b0 b1 =
            if r1 = 0 then a0 else
                let q1 = r0 / r1 in
                eg r1 (r0 mod r1) a1 (a0 - q1 * a1) b1 (b0 - q1 * b1)
        in
        eg x y 1 0 0 1
    in
    let inv x y = (* 1/x in mod y *)
        let c = extgcd x y in
        if c < 0 then c + y else c
    in
    let ( +@) a b = (a + b) mod z in
    let ( *@) a b = (a * b) mod z in
    let ( /@) a b = a *@ inv b z in
    let rec loop i pre acc =

    in

proc parseT(s: string; T: typedesc): auto =
  ## `parse` 系関数のジェネリック版
  ## `T` が `SomeOrdinal | SomeFloat` (subranges を含む) でない場合，そのまま `s` を返す
  runnableExamples:
    doAssert parseT("12", int) == 12
    doAssert parseT("12", uint) == 12
    doAssert parseT("12", int64) == 12
    doAssert parseT("12", float32) == 12.0
    doAssert parseT("Yes", bool) == true

  when T is SomeSignedInt: cast[T](parseBiggestInt(s))
  elif T is SomeUnsignedInt: cast[T](parseBiggestUInt(s))
  elif T is SomeFloat: cast[T](parseFloat(s))
  elif T is enum: parseEnum[T](s)
  elif T is bool: parseBool(s)
  elif T is char: s[0]
  else: s

proc unpackWithParse*(input: openArray[string]; T: typedesc[tuple]): T =
  ## 文字列配列を `T` で指定された `tuple` に `parse` しながら変換する
  runnableExamples:
    let t = unpackWithParse(@["1", "1", "1", "1", "1"], 4, tuple[a: int8, b: uint32, c: float64, d: bool])
    doAssert int8 is t.a.type and t.a == 1
    doAssert uint32 is t.b.type and t.b == 1
    doAssert float64 is t.c.type and t.c == 1.0
    doAssert bool is t.d.type and t.d == true
    doAssert tuple[a: int8, b: uint32, c: float64, d: bool] is t.type

  var i = 0
  for x in result.fields:
    if i > input.high:
      warn "元の配列の長さが " & $T.arity & " 未満だから，一部デフォルト値になってるよ"
      break
    x = parseT(input[i], x.type)
    i.inc
  result

proc toTupleType(parTuple: NimNode): NimNode {.compileTime.} =
  ## `nnkPar` で表現されてる名前付きタプルを `tuple[]` 形式に変換する
  ## `nnkPar` が名前付きタプルじゃない場合は，そのまま返す
  runnableExamples:
    static:
      doAssert((quote do: (a: int, b: float)).toTupleType == (quote do: tuple[a: int, b: float]))
      doAssert((quote do: (a, b: int)).toTupleType == (quote do: tuple[a, b: int]))
      doAssert((quote do: (int, int)).toTupleType == (quote do: (int, int)))
      doAssert((quote do: ()).toTupleType == (quote do: ()))

  if parTuple.len == 0 or parTuple.findChild(it.kind == nnkExprColonExpr) == nil: # () or (T, U, ...)
    result = parTuple
  else:
    result = newTree(nnkTupleTy)
    var identDefs = newTree(nnkIdentDefs)
    for field in parTuple:
      if field.kind == nnkIdent: # (a, b, ..., x: T)  の a, b, ... 部分 (x 以外)
        identDefs.add(field)
      field.copyChildrenTo(identDefs)
      if field.kind != nnkIdent: # (..., x: T, y: ...) の x: T 部分
        identDefs.add(newEmptyNode())
        result.add(identDefs)
        identDefs = newTree(nnkIdentDefs)

proc seqInputCall(bracketTree: NimNode): NimNode {.compileTime.} =
  ## `seq[N, seq[M, ..., [seq[T]]...]]` を `newSeqWith(N, newSeqWith(M, ..., input(seq[T])...))` にする

  if bracketTree.kind != nnkBracketExpr:
    case bracketTree.kind:
      of nnkPar: # x: (Field0: ...)
        result = newCall("input", bracketTree.toTupleType)
      else: # x: T
        result = newCall("input", bracketTree)
  else:
    case bracketTree.len:
      of 2: # seq[N, ... seq[T] ...] の seq[T]
        if bracketTree[^1].kind == nnkBracketExpr:
          error("seq[seq[T]] みたいな書き方はできないって言ったでしょ！ seq[N, seq[T]] みたいに書き直してっ")
        result = newCall("input", bracketTree)
      of 3: # それ以外 (seq[N, ...])
        result = newCall("newSeqWith", bracketTree[1], seqInputCall(bracketTree[^1]))
      else:
        error("変な入力があるよ")

proc appendedProcCallBlocks(procCalls: NimNode; i: int): NimNode =
  ## `procCalls[i]` の関数呼び出しを
  ## .. code-block:: Nim
  ##   block:
  ##     var it = procCall(...)
  ## という形に変換しながらつなげていく
  ## 最後だけは
  ## .. code-block:: Nim
  ##   block:
  ##     var it = lastProcCall(...)
  ##     it
  ## というようにして `it` を返すようにする

  let it = ident("it")
  let procCall = procCalls[i]
  result = newStmtList(quote do:
    var `it` = `procCall`
  )
  if i == procCalls.len - 1: # 最後の要素だけは it を返すようにする
    result.add(it)
  else:
    result.add(appendedProcCallBlocks(procCalls, i + 1))
  result = newBlockStmt(result)

proc inputsImpl(pre, post: NimNode): NimNode {.compileTime.} =
  ## pre で指定された変数に post の結果を入れる

  # input() 部分の生成
  var inputCall: NimNode
  case pre.kind:
    of nnkPar: # (x, y, ...): ...
      result = newTree(nnkVarTuple)
      pre.copyChildrenTo(result)
      result.add(newEmptyNode())
      case post[0].kind:
        of nnkPar: # (x, y, ...): (T, T, ...)
          inputCall = newCall("input", post[0].toTupleType)
        of nnkTupleTy: # (x, y, ...): tuple[Field0: ...]
          inputCall = newCall("input", post)
        else: # (x, y, ...): T
          var parTupleTy = newTree(nnkPar)
          for _ in 0..<pre.len: parTupleTy.add(post[0]) # (int, int, int, ...) みたいなのを作ってる
          inputCall = newCall("input", parTupleTy)
    else: # x: ...
      result = newTree(nnkIdentDefs).add(pre).add(newEmptyNode())
      case post[0].kind:
        of nnkPar: # x: (Field0: ...)
          inputCall = newCall("input", post[0].toTupleType)
        of nnkBracketExpr:
          inputCall = seqInputCall(post[0])
        else: # x: T
          inputCall = newCall("input", post[0])

  # 関数部分の生成（ある場合）と結合
  if post.len > 1:
    let it = ident("it")
    var itStmts = when NimMajor == 0 and NimMinor < 17: newStmtList(quote do: (var `it` = `inputCall`)) # 入力の読み込み
                  else: newStmtList(quote do: (var `it` {.used.} = `inputCall`))
    itStmts.add(appendedProcCallBlocks(post, 1)) # 関数の適用
    result.add(newTree(nnkStmtListExpr, newBlockStmt(itStmts))) # 結合
  else:
    result.add(inputCall) # 結合

macro inputs*(body: untyped): untyped =
  ## 入力を受け取る
  ## 宣言の後に `it` を用いた式を（`y` みたいに用いなくてもいいんだけど）いくつでもかくことができ，
  ## その返り値が変数の値となる
  ## 式中で型が変わってもいい（下の例の `u`, `y` とか見たいな感じ）
  ##
  ## .. code-block:: Nim
  ##   inputs:
  ##     a: int
  ##     b: string
  ##     c: (x: char, y: float)
  ##     d: tuple[x: char, y: float]
  ##     e: (u, v: BiggestInt)
  ##     f: tuple[u, v: int]
  ##     g: seq[int]
  ##     h: seq[a, seq[int]]
  ##     i: seq[a, (s, t: int)]
  ##     (j, k, l): int
  ##     (m, n): (char, float)
  ##     o: seq[a, string]
  ##     (p): int
  ##     q: seq[int]; it.sorted(system.cmp)
  ##     r: seq[float]; it.sorted(cmp).filterIt(it > 0)
  ##     s: seq[char]
  ##     t: seq[2, seq[a, int]]
  ##     u: string; parseInt(it); abs(-it)
  ##     (_, v): (a: char, b: char)
  ##     (w, x): tuple[a, b: char]
  ##     y: int; "hoge"

  expectKind(body, nnkStmtList)
  result = newTree(nnkStmtList)
  var letSection = newTree(nnkLetSection)
  for decl in body:
    case decl[0].kind:
      of nnkIdent: # x: ...
        letSection.add(inputsImpl(decl[0], decl[1]))
      of nnkPar:
        expectMinLen(decl[0], 1)
        if decl[0].len == 1: # (x): ... これは x: ... と同じ扱いにしたい
          letSection.add(inputsImpl(decl[0][0], decl[1]))
        else: # (x, y, ...): ...
          letSection.add(inputsImpl(decl[0], decl[1]))
      else:
        expectKind(decl[0], {nnkIdent, nnkPar})

  result.add(letSection)

template useMint*(MOD: range[2..int.high]) =
  ## mint型を使えるようにする
  ##
  ## .. code-block:: Nim
  ##  useMint(1_000_000_007)
  ##  let (n, m) = (3.toMint, 5.toMint)

  type mint* {.inject.} = distinct int

  #--- 型変換 ---#
  proc toMint*(n: SomeInteger): mint =
    if n < -MOD: mint(n mod MOD + MOD)
    elif n < 0: mint(n + MOD)
    elif n >= MOD: mint(n mod MOD)
    else: mint(n)

  proc toInt*(n: mint): int = int(n)

  #--- 逆元 ---#
  proc inverse*(n: mint): mint =
    ## 逆元 O(log(MOD))
    ## 非再帰extGcd版: ax + by = 1 を満たす x が b を法とした a の逆元
    ## 参考: https://topcoder.g.hatena.ne.jp/iwiwi/20130105/1357363348

    var (a, x, b, y) = (MOD, 0, n.toInt, 1)
    while b != 0:
      let tmp = a div b
      a -= tmp * b; swap(a, b)
      x -= tmp * y; swap(x, y)
    assert(x.toMint.toInt * n.toInt mod MOD == 1)
    return x.toMint

  proc `~`*(n: mint): mint = n.inverse

  #--- 単項演算子 ---#
  proc `+`*(n: mint): mint {.borrow.}
  proc `-`*(n: mint): mint = mint(MOD - n.toInt)
  proc `$`*(n: mint): string {.borrow.}

  #--- 二項演算子 ---#
  # 比較 #
  template extendComparisonOperatorToInt(op: untyped) =
    proc op*(n: mint; m: int): bool = op(n, m.toMint)
    proc op*(n: int; m: mint): bool = op(n.toMint, m)

  proc `<`*(n, m: mint): bool {.borrow.}
  extendComparisonOperatorToInt(`<`)
  proc `<=`*(n, m: mint): bool {.borrow.}
  extendComparisonOperatorToInt(`<=`)
  proc `==`*(n, m: mint): bool {.borrow.}
  extendComparisonOperatorToInt(`==`)

  # 算術 #
  template extendArithmeticOperatorToInt(op: untyped) =
    proc op*(n: mint; m: int): mint = op(n, m.toMint)
    proc op*(n: int; m: mint): mint = op(n.toMint, m)

  proc `mod`*(n, m: mint): mint = (n.toInt mod m.toInt).toMint
  proc `mod`*(n: mint, m: int): mint = (n.toInt mod m).toMint
  proc `mod`*(n: int, m: mint): mint = (n mod m.toInt).toMint
  proc `%`*(n, m: mint): mint = n mod m
  proc `%`*(n: mint; m: int): mint = n mod m
  proc `%`*(n: int; m: mint): mint = n mod m
  proc `+`*(n, m: mint): mint = (n.toInt + m.toInt).toMint
  extendArithmeticOperatorToInt(`+`)
  proc `-`*(n, m: mint): mint = n + (-m)
  extendArithmeticOperatorToInt(`-`)
  proc `*`*(n, m: mint): mint = (n.toInt * m.toInt).toMint
  extendArithmeticOperatorToInt(`*`)
  proc `div`*(n, m: mint): mint =
    # O(log(MOD))
    n * m.inverse
  extendArithmeticOperatorToInt(`div`)
  proc `/`*(n, m: mint): mint = n div m
  extendArithmeticOperatorToInt(`/`)

  proc mul*(n: mint; m: int): mint =
    ## MOD が大きすぎるとき用の掛け算 O(log(m))  (足し算で掛け算を計算するので)

    result = m.toMint
    var (n, m) = (n, m)
    while m != 0:
      if (m and 1) == 1: result = result + n
      n = n + n
      m = m shr 1
  proc mul*(n, m: mint): mint = mul(n, m.toInt)
  proc mul*(n: int; m: mint): mint = mul(m, n)

  # 算術代入 #
  proc `%=`*(n: var mint; m: mint | int) = (n = n % m.int)
  proc `+=`*(n: var mint; m: mint | int) = (n = n + m.int)
  proc `-=`*(n: var mint; m: mint | int) = (n = n - m.int)
  proc `*=`*(n: var mint; m: mint | int) = (n = n * m.int)
  proc `/=`*(n: var mint; m: mint | int) = (n = n / m.int)

  #--- 累乗 ---#
  proc pow*(n: mint; m: int): mint =
    # O(log(m))
    if m < 0: return pow(n.inverse, -m)
    var (nn, mm) = (n, m)
    result = 1.toMint
    while mm != 0:
      if (mm and 1) == 1: result = result * nn
      nn = nn * nn
      mm = mm shr 1
  proc pow*(n, m: mint): mint = n.pow(m.toInt)
  proc pow*(n: int; m: mint): mint = n.toMint.pow(m.toInt)

  proc `^`*(n, m: mint): mint = n.pow(m)
  proc `^`*(n: mint; m: int): mint = n.pow(m)
  proc `^`*(n: int; m: mint): mint = n.pow(m) # これは戻り値が mint でいいのか疑問ではある

  #--- その他関数 ---#
  proc succ*(x: mint; y: int = 1): mint = x + y
  proc succ*(x: mint; y: mint): mint = x + y

  proc pred*(x: mint; y: int = 1): mint = x - y
  proc pred*(x: mint; y: mint): mint = x - y

  proc inc*(x: var mint; y: int = 1) = (x += y)
  proc inc*(x: var mint; y: mint) = (x += y)

  proc dec*(x: var mint; y: int = 1) = (x -= y)
  proc dec*(x: var mint; y: mint) = (x -= y)

  template useNumberOfCases*(size = 3_000_000) =
    ## 場合の数（組み合わせとか）関係の関数も使えるようにする
    ##
    ## .. code-block:: Nim
    ##  useMint(1_000_000_007)
    ##  useNumberOfCases(1_000_000)
    ##  let (n, m) = (3.toMint, 5.toMint)
    ##  m.C(n) # => 10

    proc init(): tuple[facs, facInvs: seq[mint]] =
      ## MODを法とした階乗テーブルとその逆元テーブルの作成
      result = (newSeq[mint](size + 1), newSeq[mint](size + 1))

      result.facs[0] = mint(1)
      for i in 1..size:
        result.facs[i] = result.facs[i - 1] * i

      result.facInvs[size] = result.facs[size].inverse
      for i in countdown(size - 1, 0):
        result.facInvs[i] = result.facInvs[i + 1] * (i + 1)

    let (facs, facInvs) = init() # const にすると too many iterations

    template extendNumberOfCases(f: untyped) =
      ## mint と int を混ぜたり，int だけで
      ## 使ってもいいように場合の数を求める関数を拡張する

      proc f*(n: mint; r: int): mint = f(n, mint(r))
      proc f*(n: int; r: mint): mint = f(mint(n), r)
      proc f*(n, r: int): int = f(mint(n), mint(r)).toInt

    proc C*(n, r: mint): mint =
      let (n, r) = (n.toInt, r.toInt)
      if r < 0 or n < r: mint(0)
      else: facs[n] * facInvs[r] * facInvs[n - r]
    extendNumberOfCases(C)

    proc P*(n, r: mint): mint =
      let (n, r) = (n.toInt, r.toInt)
      if r < 0 or n < r: mint(0)
      else: facs[n] * facInvs[n - r]
    extendNumberOfCases(P)

    proc H*(n, r: mint): mint =
      if r == 0: mint(1)
      else: C(n + r - 1, r)
    extendNumberOfCases(H)

import math, sets

proc guchoku(): HashSet[string] =
  result = initHashSet[string]()

  proc dfs(now: string; X: var HashSet[string]) =
    if now.len > N + K: return
    if now.len == N + K: X.incl(now); return
    for i, _ in now:
      for c in 'a'..'z':
        var next = now
        next.insert($c, i)
        dfs(next, X)
    for c in 'a'..'z':
      var next = now
      next.add c
      dfs(next, X)

  dfs(S, result)

proc binpow(A, B, m: int): int =
  var a = A
  var b = B
  result = 1

proc `!=`[Mod: static[int],T](a:ModInt[Mod], b:T):bool = a.v != initModInt(b, Mod).v

  if self.v == 0: return self
  else: return ModInt[Mod](v:Mod - self.v)

  self.v += initModInt(a, Mod).v
  if self.v >= Mod: self.v -= Mod
proc `-=`[Mod: static[int], T](self:var ModInt[Mod], a:T) =
  self.v -= initModInt(a, Mod).v
  if self.v < 0: self.v += Mod

  var (x,n,a) = (self,n,self.Identity)
  while n > 0:
    if (n and 1) > 0: a *= x
    x *= x
    n = (n shr 1)
  swap(self, a)

  var
    a = self.v.int
    b = Mod
    u = 1
    v = 0
  while b > 0:
    let t = a div b
    a -= t * b;swap(a,b)

import sequtils

proc `/`(a, b:int):int = a div b

proc fact(T:typedesc, k:int):T =
  var fact_a{.global.} = @[T(1)]
  if k >= fact_a.len:
    let sz_old = fact_a.len - 1
    let sz = max(sz_old * 2, k)
    fact_a.setlen(sz + 1)
    for i in sz_old + 1..sz: fact_a[i] = fact_a[i-1] * T(i)
  return fact_a[k]
proc rfact(T:typedesc, k:int):T =
  var rfact_a{.global.} = @[T(1)]
  if k >= rfact_a.len:
    let sz_old = rfact_a.len - 1
    let sz = max(sz_old * 2, k)
    rfact_a.setlen(sz + 1)
    rfact_a[sz] = T(1) / T.fact(sz)
    for i in countdown(sz - 1, sz_old + 1): rfact_a[i] = rfact_a[i + 1] * T(i + 1)
  return rfact_a[k]

proc inv(T:typedesc, k:int):T =
  return T.fact_a(k - 1) * T.rfact(k)

proc P(T:typedesc, n,r:int):T =
  if r < 0 or n < r: return T(0)
  return T.fact(n) * T.rfact(n - r)
proc C(T:typedesc, p,q:int):T =
  if q < 0 or p < q: return T(0)
  return T.fact(p) * T.rfact(q) * T.rfact(p - q)
proc H(T: typedesc, n,r:int):T =
  if n < 0 or r < 0: return T(0)
  return if r == 0: T(1) else: T.C(n + r - 1, r)

template useMint*(MOD: range[2..int.high]) =
  ## mint型を使えるようにする
  ##
  ## .. code-block:: Nim
  ##  useMint(1_000_000_007)
  ##  let (n, m) = (3.toMint, 5.toMint)

  type mint* {.inject.} = distinct int

  #--- 型変換 ---#
  proc toMint*(n: SomeInteger): mint =
    if n < -MOD: mint(n mod MOD + MOD)
    elif n < 0: mint(n + MOD)
    elif n >= MOD: mint(n mod MOD)
    else: mint(n)

  proc toInt*(n: mint): int = int(n)

  #--- 逆元 ---#
  proc inverse*(n: mint): mint =
    ## 逆元 O(log(MOD))
    ## 非再帰extGcd版: ax + by = 1 を満たす x が b を法とした a の逆元
    ## 参考: https://topcoder.g.hatena.ne.jp/iwiwi/20130105/1357363348

    var (a, x, b, y) = (MOD, 0, n.toInt, 1)
    while b != 0:
      let tmp = a div b
      a -= tmp * b; swap(a, b)
      x -= tmp * y; swap(x, y)
    assert(x.toMint.toInt * n.toInt mod MOD == 1)
    return x.toMint

  proc `~`*(n: mint): mint = n.inverse

  #--- 単項演算子 ---#
  proc `+`*(n: mint): mint {.borrow.}
  proc `-`*(n: mint): mint = mint(MOD - n.toInt)
  proc `$`*(n: mint): string {.borrow.}

  #--- 二項演算子 ---#
  # 比較 #
  template extendComparisonOperatorToInt(op: untyped) =
    proc op*(n: mint; m: int): bool = op(n, m.toMint)
    proc op*(n: int; m: mint): bool = op(n.toMint, m)

  proc `<`*(n, m: mint): bool {.borrow.}
  extendComparisonOperatorToInt(`<`)
  proc `<=`*(n, m: mint): bool {.borrow.}
  extendComparisonOperatorToInt(`<=`)
  proc `==`*(n, m: mint): bool {.borrow.}
  extendComparisonOperatorToInt(`==`)

  # 算術 #
  template extendArithmeticOperatorToInt(op: untyped) =
    proc op*(n: mint; m: int): mint = op(n, m.toMint)
    proc op*(n: int; m: mint): mint = op(n.toMint, m)

  proc `mod`*(n, m: mint): mint = (n.toInt mod m.toInt).toMint
  proc `mod`*(n: mint, m: int): mint = (n.toInt mod m).toMint
  proc `mod`*(n: int, m: mint): mint = (n mod m.toInt).toMint
  proc `%`*(n, m: mint): mint = n mod m
  proc `%`*(n: mint; m: int): mint = n mod m
  proc `%`*(n: int; m: mint): mint = n mod m
  proc `+`*(n, m: mint): mint = (n.toInt + m.toInt).toMint
  extendArithmeticOperatorToInt(`+`)
  proc `-`*(n, m: mint): mint = n + (-m)
  extendArithmeticOperatorToInt(`-`)
  proc `*`*(n, m: mint): mint = (n.toInt * m.toInt).toMint
  extendArithmeticOperatorToInt(`*`)
  proc `div`*(n, m: mint): mint =
    # O(log(MOD))
    n * m.inverse
  extendArithmeticOperatorToInt(`div`)
  proc `/`*(n, m: mint): mint = n div m
  extendArithmeticOperatorToInt(`/`)

  proc mul*(n: mint; m: int): mint =
    ## MOD が大きすぎるとき用の掛け算 O(log(m))  (足し算で掛け算を計算するので)

    result = m.toMint
    var (n, m) = (n, m)
    while m != 0:
      if (m and 1) == 1: result = result + n
      n = n + n
      m = m shr 1
  proc mul*(n, m: mint): mint = mul(n, m.toInt)
  proc mul*(n: int; m: mint): mint = mul(m, n)

  # 算術代入 #
  proc `%=`*(n: var mint; m: mint | int) = (n = n % m.int)
  proc `+=`*(n: var mint; m: mint | int) = (n = n + m.int)
  proc `-=`*(n: var mint; m: mint | int) = (n = n - m.int)
  proc `*=`*(n: var mint; m: mint | int) = (n = n * m.int)
  proc `/=`*(n: var mint; m: mint | int) = (n = n / m.int)

  #--- 累乗 ---#
  proc pow*(n: mint; m: int): mint =
    # O(log(m))
    if m < 0: return pow(n.inverse, -m)
    var (nn, mm) = (n, m)
    result = 1.toMint
    while mm != 0:
      if (mm and 1) == 1: result = result * nn
      nn = nn * nn
      mm = mm shr 1
  proc pow*(n, m: mint): mint = n.pow(m.toInt)
  proc pow*(n: int; m: mint): mint = n.toMint.pow(m.toInt)

  proc `^`*(n, m: mint): mint = n.pow(m)
  proc `^`*(n: mint; m: int): mint = n.pow(m)
  proc `^`*(n: int; m: mint): mint = n.pow(m) # これは戻り値が mint でいいのか疑問ではある

  #--- その他関数 ---#
  proc succ*(x: mint; y: int = 1): mint = x + y
  proc succ*(x: mint; y: mint): mint = x + y

  proc pred*(x: mint; y: int = 1): mint = x - y
  proc pred*(x: mint; y: mint): mint = x - y

  proc inc*(x: var mint; y: int = 1) = (x += y)
  proc inc*(x: var mint; y: mint) = (x += y)

  proc dec*(x: var mint; y: int = 1) = (x -= y)
  proc dec*(x: var mint; y: mint) = (x -= y)

  template useNumberOfCases*(size = 3_000_000) =
    ## 場合の数（組み合わせとか）関係の関数も使えるようにする
    ##
    ## .. code-block:: Nim
    ##  useMint(1_000_000_007)
    ##  useNumberOfCases(1_000_000)
    ##  let (n, m) = (3.toMint, 5.toMint)
    ##  m.C(n) # => 10

    proc init(): tuple[facs, facInvs: seq[mint]] =
      ## MODを法とした階乗テーブルとその逆元テーブルの作成
      result = (newSeq[mint](size + 1), newSeq[mint](size + 1))

      result.facs[0] = mint(1)
      for i in 1..size:
        result.facs[i] = result.facs[i - 1] * i

      result.facInvs[size] = result.facs[size].inverse
      for i in countdown(size - 1, 0):
        result.facInvs[i] = result.facInvs[i + 1] * (i + 1)

    let (facs, facInvs) = init() # const にすると too many iterations

    template extendNumberOfCases(f: untyped) =
      ## mint と int を混ぜたり，int だけで
      ## 使ってもいいように場合の数を求める関数を拡張する

      proc f*(n: mint; r: int): mint = f(n, mint(r))
      proc f*(n: int; r: mint): mint = f(mint(n), r)
      proc f*(n, r: int): int = f(mint(n), mint(r)).toInt

    proc C*(n, r: mint): mint =
      let (n, r) = (n.toInt, r.toInt)
      if r < 0 or n < r: mint(0)
      else: facs[n] * facInvs[r] * facInvs[n - r]
    extendNumberOfCases(C)

    proc P*(n, r: mint): mint =
      let (n, r) = (n.toInt, r.toInt)
      if r < 0 or n < r: mint(0)
      else: facs[n] * facInvs[n - r]
    extendNumberOfCases(P)

    proc H*(n, r: mint): mint =
      if r == 0: mint(1)
      else: C(n + r - 1, r)
    extendNumberOfCases(H)

# Vicfred
# https://atcoder.jp/contests/abc171/tasks/abc171_f
# math, binomial coefficients
import strutils, math

let MOD = 10^9+7
let MAXN = 10^7

var fac = newSeq[int](MAXN+5)
var inv = newSeq[int](MAXN+5)
var finv = newSeq[int](MAXN+5)

proc binpow(A, B, m: int): int =
  var a = A
  var b = B
  result = 1
  a = a mod m
  while b > 0:
    if b mod 2 == 1:
      result = (result * a) mod m
    a = (a * a) mod m
    b = b div 2

proc binomial(n, k, m: int): int =
  if n < 0 or n < k:
    return 0
  var ans = fac[n] mod m
  ans *= finv[k] mod m
  ans = ans mod m
  ans *= finv[n-k] mod m
  ans = ans mod m
  return ans

fac[0] = 1
fac[1] = 1
finv[0] = 1
finv[1] = 1
inv[1] = 1

for i in 2..<MAXN:
  fac[i] = (fac[i-1]*i) mod MOD
  inv[i] = (MOD - (MOD div i) * (inv[MOD mod i] mod MOD)) mod MOD
  finv[i] = finv[i-1]*inv[i] mod MOD

let k = stdin.readLine.parseInt
let s = stdin.readLine.strip
let n = s.len

var ans = 0
for x in 0..k:
  let bin = binomial(n + k - x - 1, n - 1, MOD)
  var now = binpow(26, x, MOD)
  now *= bin
  now = now mod MOD
  now *= binpow(25, k-x, MOD)
  now = now mod MOD
  ans += now
  ans = ans mod MOD

ans = (ans+MOD) mod MOD
echo ans

proc parseT(s: string; T: typedesc): auto =
  ## `parse` 系関数のジェネリック版
  ## `T` が `SomeOrdinal | SomeFloat` (subranges を含む) でない場合，そのまま `s` を返す
  runnableExamples:
    doAssert parseT("12", int) == 12
    doAssert parseT("12", uint) == 12
    doAssert parseT("12", int64) == 12
    doAssert parseT("12", float32) == 12.0
    doAssert parseT("Yes", bool) == true

  when T is SomeSignedInt: cast[T](parseBiggestInt(s))
  elif T is SomeUnsignedInt: cast[T](parseBiggestUInt(s))
  elif T is SomeFloat: cast[T](parseFloat(s))
  elif T is enum: parseEnum[T](s)
  elif T is bool: parseBool(s)
  elif T is char: s[0]
  else: s

proc unpackWithParse*(input: openArray[string]; T: typedesc[tuple]): T =
  ## 文字列配列を `T` で指定された `tuple` に `parse` しながら変換する
  runnableExamples:
    let t = unpackWithParse(@["1", "1", "1", "1", "1"], 4, tuple[a: int8, b: uint32, c: float64, d: bool])
    doAssert int8 is t.a.type and t.a == 1
    doAssert uint32 is t.b.type and t.b == 1
    doAssert float64 is t.c.type and t.c == 1.0
    doAssert bool is t.d.type and t.d == true
    doAssert tuple[a: int8, b: uint32, c: float64, d: bool] is t.type

  var i = 0
  for x in result.fields:
    if i > input.high:
      warn "元の配列の長さが " & $T.arity & " 未満だから，一部デフォルト値になってるよ"
      break
    x = parseT(input[i], x.type)
    i.inc
  result
